entries.proposition: DESIGN: post hoc, retrospective analysis of two ADI-PEG 20 trial cohorts in Taiwan (113 monotherapy, 47 with chemotherapy) plus a 214-patient surgical cohort; WWOX is a germline SNP (rs13338697) used as a predictive marker, a cancer pharmacogenetic setting, not WWOX loss of function in disease.
entries.snippet: 214 HCC patients who had undergone surgical resection for HCC at Chang Gung Memorial Hospital a

entries.proposition: The headline: OS is longer in rs13338697 GG carriers on ADI-PEG 20 monotherapy (15.1 versus 8.1 months, Cox P 0.025), in cohort-1 only.
entries.snippet: patients with the WWOX-rs13338697-GG genotype had a longer OS compared to those with the WWOX-rs13338697-non-GG genotype (mean OS, 15.1 months [95% CI: 6.7-23.4] versus 8.1 months [95% CI: 6

entries.proposition: Figure 1B: the GG group in cohort-1 is nine patients (against 44 AG and 60 AA); the GG curve has three or fewer patients beyond 20 months; log-rank P 0.020 and 0.018 and 0.024 for pairwise comparisons.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1, overall survival Kaplan-Meier: (A) tumour number, (B) WWOX-rs13338697 AA versus non-AA (P 0.252), GG versus non-GG (P 0.020), three genotypes with n 9 GG, 44 A/G, 60 AA; (C) rs6025211; (D) GALNT14-rs9679162.

experimental_context.system: advanced HCC patients on ADI-PEG 20 monotherapy, cohort-1

entries.proposition: Figure 3B: pooling both trial cohorts (160 patients) the WWOX GG advantage disappears (GG versus non-GG P 0.127; GG n 14); only tumour number remains significant for OS. The GG result is therefore specific to the monotherapy cohort and is lost in the larger pooled sample.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3, overall survival in all 160 patients: (A) tumour number, (B) WWOX-rs13338697 AA versus non-AA (P 0.612), GG versus non-GG (P 0.127), three genotypes with n 14 GG, 59 A/G, 87 AA; (C) rs6025211 (TT versus CC P 0.047); (D) GALNT14.

entries.proposition: The SNP is not prognostic after surgical resection (214 patients), which the authors take to show it is specific to ADI-PEG 20 efficacy.
